### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**5** anchor(s) derived from **1** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them. ⚠️ **5** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/authorable-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/declaration-map/ui.json`, …), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **5** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/api-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/authorable-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/declaration-map/ui.json`, …) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **137** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 9905e61ca2fddb43d266c23cdb12ced5019c1a74` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `f94385ab56cd01d1f71ff7a9f34bc38ea5ed9a4e` — the merge of head `98dad84e210101e764efd40d32446187ffed7c92` into base `9905e61ca2fddb43d266c23cdb12ced5019c1a74`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin f94385ab56cd01d1f71ff7a9f34bc38ea5ed9a4e && git checkout f94385ab56cd01d1f71ff7a9f34bc38ea5ed9a4e
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 9905e61ca2fddb43d266c23cdb12ced5019c1a74 98dad84e210101e764efd40d32446187ffed7c92 && git checkout -B drift-repro 9905e61ca2fddb43d266c23cdb12ced5019c1a74 && git merge --no-ff 98dad84e210101e764efd40d32446187ffed7c92

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 9905e61ca2fddb43d266c23cdb12ced5019c1a74
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `98dad84e210101e764efd40d32446187ffed7c92`
Local-runs: none

Inputs, and nothing else: card #20694 (body and all 7 comments: triage `5897622232`, the two deferrals `5899525593` / `5908413139`, the restart probe `5905205373`, the serial correction `5910094526`, the claim `5912442541`, the dev's `os-dev-report` `5914012653`); PR #20882's body, its 13-file list and the net diff `origin/main...refs/review/pr20882` (353 additions / 34 deletions, merge-base `07356a6ab0`, `origin/main` at `0803a8b871` when fetched, one commit past the `9905e61ca2` the PR body names); the check-runs on the head. Renderer claims were read at objectstack's pin `.objectui-sha` = `db11afd4967cd9d39381c5e21dc2deec9d706204` with `git show` in objectui. Nothing was built, run or re-run; the only local git act was a driverless `merge-tree --write-tree` from a bare shared clone in scratch, a read.

### ① Derived judgments

Every accept-set and public-surface change the diff implies, each named right or wrong.

1. **`ComponentPropsMap['object-grid']` (`ObjectGridPropsSchema`) accepts three new top-level keys** and nothing else changes in its accept set. `description: I18nLabelSchema.optional()` — RIGHT: read at the pin, `plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx:5677` `resolveInlineI18nLabel(schema.description, displayLocale)`, drawn at `:5784`, `:6303`, `:6342` (all five lines verified; the card's `resolveI18nLabel` is a misnaming, the docblock records the real name). `emptyState: EmptyStateSchema.optional()` — RIGHT: read at `:6225` (`schema.emptyState`), drawn through `DataEmptyState` at `:6233` with the gating the docblock describes (`!loading`, not search-emptied, zero rows / zero groups, `:6227-6231`). `keyboardNavigation: z.boolean().optional()` — RIGHT per triage's fold from objectui#11068's BUILD: `git grep` at the pin over objectui `packages/` and `apps/`, excluding tests, CHANGELOGs, READMEs and `packages/types`, returns zero hits, against the control `schema.editable` at `ObjectGrid.tsx:1708`, `:1736`, `:1756`. The describe is the one triage specified, prefixed `[EXPERIMENTAL — not enforced]`, which `packages/spec/scripts/liveness/check-liveness.mts:500-505` (`MARKER_RE.experimental`) classifies as `experimental` — declared, not enforced, a status the ledger recognises (`:60-61`). The block docblock's own convention (keys derived from renderer read points) is deliberately departed from for this one key, and the docblock says so and says when to drop the marker. Not an advertised capability: the describe, the reference row and the changeset each say authoring it changes nothing today.
2. **The row stays closed.** The unknown-key control in `component-object-grid-declared-keys.pin.test.ts` §2 pins `unrecognized_keys` at the row for `notAGridKey`, plus code AND path for a wrong value in each new member. RIGHT — a widening that proves it did not open the row.
3. **`EmptyStateSchema` is extracted from `ListViewShapeSchema.emptyState` (`view.zod.ts:2879` at `origin/main`) and both doors hold it by reference.** Shape is byte-for-byte the former inline one: `strictObject` with the same `surface`, `history: VIEW_HISTORY`, the same six `aliases`, members `title?: I18nLabel`, `message?: I18nLabel`, `icon?: string`. `StrictObjectOptions.aliases` / `.guidance` are refusal-text options (`strict-object.ts:150`, `:155`), so the list view's accept set is unchanged; the dev's 112-cell corpus (success, data, codes, paths identical) is consistent with the shape read. RIGHT. Triage's ⛔ "not a second shape" is honoured, and §3 of the pin asserts identity of `_zod.def` on both doors, so a later copy reds.
4. **One refusal TEXT changes**: the `action` / `button` guidance now reads true on both doors (still names `addRecord`). `git grep` at `origin/main` finds the old sentence only in `view.zod.ts:2888-2889` itself; no test pins it. Message text is not contract; codes and paths are. RIGHT.
5. **Public surface widens by two exports on `@objectstack/spec/ui`**: `EmptyStateSchema (const)` and `EmptyState (type)` — recorded in `api-surface/ui.json`, `declaration-map/ui.json`, `export-origins/ui.json`, `json-schema.manifest/ui.json` (`ui/EmptyState`), and `authorable-surface/ui.json` (`ui/EmptyState:{icon,message,title}` plus `ui/ObjectGridProps:{description,emptyState,keyboardNavigation}`). No existing `EmptyState` / `EmptyStateSchema` name in `packages/spec/src` at `origin/main`, and objectui at the pin has no `export * from '@objectstack/spec…'`, so the new names collide with nothing. RIGHT, additive.
6. **ADR-0122 alias**: `export type EmptyState = z.input` with an isomorphic pin (`Iso_ui_view__EmptyStateSchema`, 779 to 780). `I18nLabelSchema` is a `z.union([z.string(), InlineLocaleMapSchema])` and `InlineLocaleMapSchema` a `z.record` — no default, no transform anywhere in the tree — so `z.input === z.infer` and an `EmptyStateParsed` synonym would be wrong. RIGHT.
7. **Generated docs** (`content/docs/references/ui/component.mdx`, `view.mdx`, `index.mdx` 1524 to 1525 schemas) and the five spec artefacts read as the generators' output for this source delta; `Type Check · source gates` (the job the artefact gates ride) reads `success`.
8. **Net diff against a moved `main`.** `origin/main` gained #20868 (`view.zod.ts` hunks at 398, 487, 903, 1631, 2611, 5095, 5202, 5239, 5262, 5346, 5377, 6111; `view.mdx` two `options` rows at 2260 / 2361) and #20875 (`app.zod.ts`, `app.mdx`); this branch's `view.zod.ts` hunks are at 1719, 2872, 7146 and its `view.mdx` hunks at 59, 160, 1128, 1511 — disjoint. `component.zod.ts` is untouched on `main` since the merge-base. A driverless `git merge-tree --write-tree` (bare shared clone, `merge.os-regen.driver` unset) against `0803a8b871` writes a tree with no conflicted path (exit 0); the same against `9905e61ca2` also clean. The queue's rebuilt generation re-runs the artefact gates on the textual merge, which is where a jointly-wrong generated file would surface.
9. **Check-runs on `98dad84e21`** at my last read (2026-09-30T15:17Z), 33 runs: every completed run reads `success` except `Console Pin Gate` and `Packed-tarball smoke (opt-in)`, both `skipped` (path-filtered; the diff removes nothing the pinned sibling imports). Still `in_progress` at that read: `Lint & Repo Gates`, `Test Core (1/6, 4/6, 5/6, 6/6)`, `Type Check · workspace`. Of the seven required contexts, `Build Core`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL)` and `Governed Surface Queue Guard` read `success`; `Lint & Repo Gates`, `Test Core` and `TypeScript Type Check` were not yet concluded. `Spec property liveness`, `Check Changeset`, `The card this PR closes must claim this branch`, `No other open PR may claim the same issue` all `success`. This record judges the contract; the landing still waits on every required context reading `success` (§7).

No governed-surface path in the file list; head repo equals base repo; 387 changed lines.

### ② Semver level

- `.changeset/20694-object-grid-description-empty-state-keyboard-navigation.md`: `'@objectstack/spec': minor`. The only released package the diff touches is `@objectstack/spec` (`content/docs/**` publishes nothing). RIGHT.
- The diff publishes: three optional keys on a strict authorable shape, two new exports, one refusal message reworded, no removal, no rename, no narrowing — nothing that parsed before is refused (§1 above). A `minor` widening, no migration owed. RIGHT.
- `Clause-②: yes (widening)` in the changeset; `Clause-②: yes` in the PR body — one declaration, `yes` with the `(widening)` arm, matching triage's grade (`5897622232`) and the claim (`5912442541`), and `yes` takes at least `minor`, which it has. `Check Changeset` reads `success`.
- The changeset body carries the interim authoring guidance for the renderer gap (write plain strings on `object-grid`'s `emptyState.title` / `.message`), which is the right place for it since it ships as `CHANGELOG.md`.

Clause-②: yes (widening) — `minor`, matches the diff.

### ③ Boundary flags

Every dev flag and every `open_questions` entry, answered or escalated.

- **Deviation 1 — the guidance sentence reworded on the list-view doors.** ANSWERED, accepted: accept set unchanged (①.3), text not contract, no test pins the old sentence (①.4), `addRecord` still named, and the `VIEW_ROW_BOUND_GUIDANCE` precedent covers text two doors share.
- **Deviation 2 — no liveness ledger row; the describe marker is the record.** ANSWERED, accepted: `page/regions` is in `scripts/liveness/undrilled-containers.baseline.json:113` and `PageComponent.properties` is an open record, so a `page.json` row would be an orphan; `MARKER_RE.experimental` recognises the marker (①.1); `Spec property liveness` reads `success`. The member docblock says to drop the marker in the change that lands the reader — that instruction is the ADR-0049 hand-off.
- **Deviation 3 — `type-alias-convention.pin.test.ts` outside the claimed surface.** ANSWERED, accepted: a mechanical consequence of exporting `EmptyState` (gen:docs refuses an undocumented-alias schema); the pin's shape is right (①.6); count 779 to 780 with the rationale recorded at the assertion.
- **Deviation 4 — the list-view reference docs lose the inherited "resolved at render time" sentence.** ANSWERED, accepted: at the pin `plugin-list/src/ListView.tsx:5112` / `:5114` guard `typeof … === 'string'` and drop a map to the default text, so the inherited sentence overstated the renderer; the member describes now say what the members are without claiming resolution.
- **Deviation 5 — `os-regen-merge.sh` step 3 regeneration committed separately as `98dad84e21`.** ANSWERED, procedural: the head under review is the regenerated state; the artefact gates ride `Type Check · source gates` (`success`); the queue re-validates the merge ref.
- **Deviation 6 — card names `resolveI18nLabel`, pin has `resolveInlineI18nLabel`.** ANSWERED: verified at `ObjectGrid.tsx:5677`; the docblock records the real name. Correct.
- **Open question 1 — should the objectui follow-up filed at ACCEPT also carry the renderer fix for an inline locale map in `emptyState.title` / `.message`?** ANSWERED: **A**, and the spec declaration stands as it is. Verified at the pin: `ObjectGrid.tsx:6241-6242` pass `authoredEmptyState?.title || t('table.noResults')` and `authoredEmptyState?.message || undefined` to `DataEmptyState` unresolved, unlike `description` at `:5677`; and objectui's own twin `packages/types/src/zod/objectql.zod.ts:392-399` declares the two members as `z.string()`, narrower than this shape. Triage ruled one shape with `I18nLabel` members and that objectui's twin follows the spec, not the reverse (`5897622232`), and Prime Directive #12 puts the catch-up on the consumer. So option C is rightly rejected, and B would split one objectui change into two cards for no gain. The seat's ACCEPT-time objectui follow-up card names all three, in its body, so none rides in silently: (i) `GRID_QUERY_INPUTS` lists `description`, `emptyState`, `keyboardNavigation` (the parity gate's reverse direction, per triage); (ii) the twin's `emptyState.title` / `.message` widen to the spec's `I18nLabel`; (iii) `resolveInlineI18nLabel` applied at `ObjectGrid.tsx:6241-6242` and at `ListView.tsx:5112` / `:5114`. Blocked-by the spec release being installable. Until then the changeset's "write plain strings" line is the authoring guidance, and the ⚠️ paragraph in the member docblock keeps the declaration honest (Prime Directive #10: the gap is stated, not advertised over).
- **Out-of-scope finding 1 — the same renderer gap, `reach:` no named producer.** ANSWERED: verified as above; carrier is the objectui follow-up in the previous item; not a card on this repo. Noted, not filed here, is the right disposition — the defect is objectui's, and its card is the follow-up the seat files.
- **Acceptance note 2 — `main` moved after the merge.** ANSWERED: re-probed against the newer `0803a8b871` (①.8); clean, hunks disjoint. No second merge owed before enqueue; the queue validates the merge ref.
- **Acceptance note 3 — the objectui follow-up for `GRID_QUERY_INPUTS`.** ANSWERED: folded into the single follow-up card above, per triage.
- **`keyboardNavigation` declared ahead of any reader** (the row's docblock convention is read-point-derived). ANSWERED, not escalated: triage's fold (`5897622232`, confirmed by the restart probe `5905205373`) directed it, the ledger's `experimental` class is the recorded status, the reference row says "No renderer reads it yet", and objectui#11068's BUILD is the reader's card. The marker-drop instruction in the member docblock is the exit.

Nothing escalated.
